findings.note: gnark documents that MarshalG1 omits the modulus check unless the caller passes algopts.WithCanonicalBitRepresentation(): non-canonical bits are acceptable when they only feed a hash-derived challenge, where a wrong encoding fails verification, and must not be compared directly. The rule is right that the decomposition is not unique; callers comparing bits must opt in.
